text.title: Impressions the publisher counted against impressions the advertiser counted
text.lede: Two ad servers never agree exactly, so the question is how far apart they are. Each campaign is a dot on one scale of percentage difference. Inside the grey band is normal. A dot outside it trails a stem back to zero, in the colour of the side that counted more.
text.chartTitle: Advertiser count against publisher count, by campaign
text.chartSub: March 2026. The band is the 10% the contract allows. Sorted by size of difference. Select a campaign.
text.noReason: Inside the 10% the contract allows. Normal loss between two ad servers.

records.name: Spring sale, homepage takeover
records.reason: The advertiser’s tag loads late on mobile. A quarter of impressions are served and never counted by them.

records.name: Loyalty app installs
records.reason: The advertiser counts every ad request. The publisher counts only ads that rendered.

records.name: Summer preview, video
records.reason: Video players in one placement block the advertiser’s tracking pixel.

records.name: Weekend flash, interstitial
records.reason: The publisher’s report lists this line once. The advertiser’s export lists it twice, under two campaign IDs.

records.name: Podcast audio spots
records.reason: Delivered by the publisher. The advertiser’s server has no line for it: the tracking tag was never added.

records.name: Winter carry-over
records.reason: The advertiser counted impressions for a campaign the publisher ended in February. A cached tag is still firing somewhere.
